technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with short-term overbought conditions and intermediate-term resistance; moderate confluence on trend structure but lacks momentum confirmation for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: FAST shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 36 days.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (37 VIX-equivalent) with bearish sentiment (41%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (243+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (450.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 36 days creates binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (SMA 9/21), bullish Supertrend, and ADX directional strength suggest emerging uptrend structure with price near support (24.11) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is hostile (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price remains below 50-SMA and EMA-50 (intermediate resistance), stochastic overbought with bearish cross signals imminent pullback, and earnings binary event in 36 days creates uncompensated tail risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and Supertrend suggest emerging uptrend structure with price at support, but macro environment (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY) and stochastic overbought conditions with bearish cross create uncompensated risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 36 days combined with VIX crisis levels and intermediate-term price weakness below 50-SMA creates tail risk that outweighs technical setup strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing FAST position and 19 open Industrials positions create sector concentration; skip reduces redundancy and preserves capital for higher-conviction setups in macro headwind environment.
